name: deployment-operations
description: Production deployment discipline for term_5-managed Docker applications: source control, health gates, reverse proxy, TLS, release records and rollback.
guidelines: Treat deployment as a release transaction, not as a sequence of unrelated commands.
Require a clean Git working tree before a production release unless the user explicitly changes that policy.
Build and health-check the application before changing public routing.
Validate Nginx before reload and verify the public endpoint after routing/TLS changes.
Record current and previous release commits so rollback has an explicit target.
Never delete Docker volumes as part of deployment or code rollback.
definition_of_done: public reverse proxy validates and reloads successfully when configured
HTTPS probe succeeds when TLS is requested
release commit is recorded only after health gates pass
previous release remains known for rollback
